summary: Refined Phase 2 frontend lane for stable demo: reflection evidence now enforces 1-line meaning when evidence is selected (or explicit skip by empty selection), and replay payload is strictly constrained to a 7-day read-only 3-tier model (T1 completed, T2 interrupted, T3 supporting evidence) with close/skip exit controls preserved.

outputs.description: Added strict replay payload builder, timestamp parsing guard, evidence meaning validation, and replay tier counters/CTA fallback labels.
Aligned 3D CTA wording to Close Replay + Skip and normalized tier mapping to case-insensitive meta type handling.
Added regression tests for strict 7-day filtering, 3-tier counting, and replay limit behavior.
Fast-lane L1 update for CT aggregation.
Lane handoff artifact for Phase 2 frontend iteration refresh.

evidence.name: plan_focus_journal_route_presence
evidence.command: rg -n 'Plan Start|Focus Now' app.py && rg -n 'elif m == "desk"|elif m == "chronos"|elif m == "control"' app.py
evidence.note: Confirmed Plan-first, Focus-first, and Journal route hooks remain reachable in current router/UI.

evidence.name: reflection_evidence_curation_guard
evidence.command: rg -n 'Evidence Curation|max_selections=2|증거 선택을 해제해 Skip|meta_type="supporting_evidence"' app.py
evidence.note: Confirmed 1~2 curation cap, 1-line meaning validation, and supporting_evidence persistence path.

evidence.name: replay_7day_3tier_and_cta
evidence.command: rg -n '_build_weekly_replay_payload|7-Day Read-Only Replay|Close Replay \(UI Fallback\)|Skip Replay \(UI Fallback\)' app.py && rg -n 'Tier 1: Completed|Tier 2: Interrupted|Tier 3: Evidence|Close Replay|REPLAY_SKIP' universe_3d.py
evidence.note: Confirmed strict replay helper, tier labels, and close/skip exit controls.

risks.description: 3D iframe postMessage close/skip depends on host-side handling; Streamlit fallback buttons remain required for deterministic demo exit.
Strict timestamp parsing excludes malformed legacy logs from replay, which may reduce visible node count in older datasets.
risks.mitigation: This is intentional for fixed 7-day replay correctness; legacy logs still remain available in non-replay views.
